beats.en: An indicator changes colour in acids and bases. Litmus paper turns from blue to red in acid and from red to blue in base. Yellow turmeric turns reddish brown in a basic solution.

textbookBox.concept: Acids are used in food and in cleaning. Bases are used in soaps and antacids. When an acid reacts with a base in neutralisation, salt and water can form and heat can be released.
